description: The realm primitive exists from day one: a single default realm issues `aud`-scoped tokens, and verification rejects a token whose `aud` does not match the verifying realm (no cross-tenant acceptance even with one realm).

requirements.description: A default realm must exist from initial boot. All tokens issued by a realm carry an aud claim set to that realm's identifier. Token verification must reject any token whose aud does not match the verifying realm. Cross-realm token acceptance is explicitly forbidden even when only one realm exists. The realm primitive provides the foundation for multi-tenancy in P1.
requirements.title: Default Realm Primitive with aud-Scoped Token Issuance and Rejection
